Name: Hidden
Description: Runs the game client off-screen during compile.

Name: Text Mode
Description: Runs the game client in text mode only. Removes rendering cost per frame, which is pure overhead during generation.

Name: Fast - No Visibility Data
Description: Skips visibility data, which is normally the slowest part of nav generation. The walkable mesh itself is unaffected - only hiding and sniper spot data is left out.
Warning: Bots will not have hiding spot or sniper spot data

Name: Visibility Range
Description: Limits how far the visibility computation looks, instead of skipping it entirely. Lower values compile faster but bots lose some long-range awareness. Ignored if 'Fast - No Visibility Data' is also on.

Name: No Addons
Description: Disables Workshop addons during generation. They don't affect the result, just slow it down.

Name: No Workshop Download
Description: Skips Workshop content mounting entirely, cutting startup time before generation begins.

Name: No Sound
Warning: Can cause crashes on certain engine branches

Name: Command Line Argument
Description: Passes value as a command line argument
